question.text: A dividend of Rs. 5 grows at 7% forever; required return 15%. Intrinsic value per DDM:

explanation.text: The Logic: Next year's D1 = 5 × 1.07 = 5.35. P = 5.35 / (0.15 - 0.07) = 5.35 / 0.08 = Rs. 66.88 ≈ Rs. 67. The Trap: Rs. 62.5 uses D0 instead of D1. Cross-Exam Context: DDM practice. Manager's Pro-Tip: Forward dividend (D1) is the correct numerator; distinguish carefully.
